title: Blueberry Infused Tobacco | The Tobacconist by Cuttwood E Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Blueberry Infused Tobacco 100ml Short Fill:
Indulge in a perfectly balanced blend of bold, smoky tobacco and sweet, succulent blueberries with Blueberry Infused Tobacco from The Tobacconist by Cuttwood. This distinctive mix brings together the rich, satisfying depth of tobacco with the refreshing twist of berry, creating a smooth and unexpected fusion. Ideal for those who enjoy a traditional tobacco profile with an adventurous fruity edge, this flavour offers a satisfying alternative to the usual tobacco options, making it a unique choice for those seeking something different. It’s a true delight that will appeal to both tobacco lovers and berry enthusiasts alike.
American e-liquid giants Cuttwood are back with their exquisite Tobacconist range of shortfill liquids. With 6 different tobacco profiles, each designed to captivate your senses, this collection is sure to impress those seeking a bold and flavourful blend.
Product Features:
Brand:
Cuttwood
Brand Origin:
USA
Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine shots have been added .
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
